scenarios.title: Search -> diff preview -> Apply -> receipt
scenarios.setup: Use the bundled demo workspace and docs/agenttrail-demo.gif flow.
scenarios.metric: User can inspect evidence, approve a diff, and export a receipt.
scenarios.limitations: This is a product-flow check, not a model speed benchmark.

scenarios.title: Local backend start path
scenarios.setup: Run npx agenttrail with Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible local backend.
scenarios.metric: Time from command to browser-ready local UI.
scenarios.limitations: Actual model download time depends on backend and network.

scenarios.title: Receipt replay inspection
scenarios.setup: Open a saved session and inspect prompt, files, model, tools, diffs, and report.
scenarios.metric: Run has enough metadata to understand what happened.
scenarios.limitations: Deterministic replay can vary by model temperature and backend behavior.
